The user wants to cancel AI code generation cleanly when pressing Escape or clicking outside, without leaving the file half-written.
I have a plan with 3 phases:
A: locator: where Escape/click outside is detected to cancel generation.
B: locator: where the partially written file is cleaned up upon canceling generation.
P: bridge: is there a path between detecting Escape/click and cleaning the file.
